title: 机器人做蛋糕
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Scene: ONE warmly expressive rounded robot baker leans forward with a delighted playful pose, holding ONE oversized piping bag over ONE big single-tier cake. The cake has ONE simple broad icing curve and exactly ONE large strawberry on top, without seed dots or tiny leaf islands. Robot has a large soft head, simple solid-black eyes and open smile, broad mitten hands with no fingers and simple broad feet; no buttons, hinges, screws or joint rings. No chef-hat stripes, sprinkles, sweets, cupcake cluster, kitchen props or background decorations. Empty white background with at most one broad tabletop curve. Plan only 10–16 broad enclosed white colorable regions, strict maximum 20 including background.

Final simplification: the friendly robot is ONE soft seamless body with a rounded rectangular head, no face bezel, no ear pieces, no joints, no neck band, no shoes or sole stripes. Face eyes are SOLID BLACK ovals without white sclera, and smile is ONE OPEN curve, no enclosed mouth. The piping bag is ONE large cone-shaped white bag with no tie loops, no small separately outlined nozzle and no crimp lines. The tip directly touches the cake icing. Cake is ONE large single tier with one broad swooping icing division and one very large seedless strawberry, NO leaf tuft or separate little leaf shapes. No sprinkles, trim borders, tray rim, kitchen backdrop or extra cake layers. 8–12 large enclosed coloring regions including background, no more than16. Every white enclosed region must comfortably fit a 7-percent-width circle, no tiny trapped gaps between hands and bag.

EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE ONLY. Preserve the cute robot baker, piping bag, big single-tier cake, one large strawberry, the happy pose and every major outer silhouette. Remove the broad horizontal GROUND LINE entirely from the background; especially its short segment between the robot leg and cake must vanish so it cannot enclose a thin white pocket. Also remove the very short vertical/diagonal connector line under the robot RIGHT forearm where it meets the cake top, just to the right of the piping bag tip: open that small narrow white wedge to the surrounding blank background instead of trapping it between forearm and cake. Keep the big icing shape and all cake contours. No new details, no background line, no changes to face or pose. Clean pure black on white.

FINAL CRITICAL EDIT OF PROVIDED IMAGE: Repair the cake outline so the icing is a completely CLOSED broad white colorable shape, separate from background. Restore the missing continuous TOP OUTER CAKE CONTOUR between the piping-bag tip and the strawberry, connecting fully to the rest of the cake outline with no gaps. To avoid the old tiny trapped gap, raise the robot lower right FOREARM curve upward about 100 image pixels, leaving a generous open-air gap at least 100px tall between arm and cake top, instead of breaking the cake border. The piping bag still extends down to touch the cake. Keep the delightful same robot face, broad bag, big cake, one strawberry and all other pose/composition unchanged. Cake icing and cake body must each remain CLOSED and clearly separately colorable, never leak to background. No background ground line, no extra objects, no new tiny shapes. Pure black on white.
visualReview: Accepted after inspecting both original PNG and all numbered region masks: expressive simple professional line art; major subject areas closed and separate from background; no narrow mechanical rings or omitted excess regions.
